title: Free-Look, Contestability and Suicide Exclusion Periods of Universal Life Insurance
content:
The periods below apply to every tier of Ashgrove Universal Life Insurance and are counted from the dates stated.

## Schedule of periods

| Item | Lifetime Guarantee UL | Protection UL | Accumulation UL | Indexed UL Protect | Indexed UL Growth | Indexed UL Premier |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Free-look period (calendar days from the policy delivery date) | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 |
| Free-look period where the sale replaced existing coverage (calendar days) | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Contestable period (years from the issue date or reinstatement date) | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 |
| Suicide exclusion period (years from the issue date) | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 |

## Reading the schedule

- The free-look figure is 10 calendar days, or 30 calendar days in place of 10 where the sale replaced existing coverage.
- The contestable period runs 2 years from the issue date, and after a reinstatement 2 years from the reinstatement date for the statements in the reinstatement application.
- The suicide exclusion period runs 2 years from the issue date.

## Hypothetical illustration

A policy delivered on 4 May with no replacement has a free-look period of 10 calendar days counted from 4 May; had the sale replaced existing coverage, the period would be 30 calendar days.
